info.title: Gymbro API
info.description: Existing Gymbro HTTP API. Service routes require the shared bot bearer secret. User routes accept that service credential or a user session (bearer or HttpOnly cookie), restricted to its own internal user ID. Authorization: Bearer takes precedence over cookies; an invalid supplied bearer never falls back to a cookie. Cookie workout/program writes also require application/json and X-Gymbro-Write: 1 (Swagger UI adds this header). Public auth/health endpoints do not require credentials, but supplied credentials are still authenticated. Documentation is always public. No permissive CORS. Use Authorize only with credentials you are permitted to use; credentials are not included or persisted by this documentation. Browser cookies are managed by the browser, not by Swagger Authorize. Browser login over HTTP requires COOKIE_SECURE=false in local configuration; prefer native bearer login otherwise.

weight.description: Non-negative kg as a decimal string, never a float.

name.description: Trimmed; absent/null defaults to the canonical type (or empty string when no type). Explicit blank is stored as an empty string.

type.description: Optional; case-insensitive known workout type, stored canonically: push+pull, push+lower, lower, upper, push, pull, full body, workout A, workout B, день 1, день 2, руки, рест. Empty string is accepted.

source.description: Session creates require mobile; service may choose source.

source_ref.description: Provenance only, never an upsert or replay key. Session creates require a UUID.

SaveWorkoutRequest.description: Creates a new workout on every request, even with duplicate source/source_ref. started_at and finished_at must be both present or both absent/null; finish must not precede start. Entry and set order is significant; both may be empty.

name.description: Trimmed; omitted, null, or blank clears the name to an empty string.

type.description: Optional; case-insensitive known workout type, stored canonically: push+pull, push+lower, lower, upper, push, pull, full body, workout A, workout B, день 1, день 2, руки, рест. Empty string is accepted.

UpdateWorkoutRequest.description: Full replacement of content without changing ID or source/source_ref. Omitted optional fields clear stored values, including name, type, intake, note, times, and entries. Paired time rules match SaveWorkoutRequest. No revision token is accepted.

SaveWorkoutResponse.description: Create or replacement result: created is true for POST and false for PUT. updated_at is modification metadata, not a required revision token.

updated_at.description: UTC modification metadata at database precision; not a mutation precondition.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor; null on last page.
